t: Meqom uzeman habbetzia, umi hu habbotzea
s: Meqom uzeman habbetzia, umi hu habbotzea, ubo k"g seipim: mitzvat aseh min hattora lebarek et Hashem achar akilat mazon, shenneemar "veakalta vesabota uberakta et Hashem vego'". Umiddibre soperim lebarek lipne kol akila ushetiyya, ameru: im keshehu sabea mebarek — keshehu raeb lo kol shekken? Vekol hanneheneh mehaolam hazzeh belo beraka — keillu neheneh miqqodshe shamayim, shenneemar "laHashem haaretz umeloah". Veal kol okel umashqeh mebarek alehem beraka kolelet lekamma minim, kemo "bore peri haadama" lekol mine perot haaretz, u"bore peri haetz" lekol perot haetz. Chutz min hayyayin vehappat, shemmittok chashibutan qabeu lahen beraka leatzman, shehayyayin hotziuhu mikkelal perot hailan lebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen", mippene chashibuto shemmesammeach et halleb, shenneemar "veyayin yesammach lebab enosh", vehappat hotziu mikkelal perot haaretz lebarek alayv "hammotzi lechem min haaretz", mippene chashibut hallechem shessoed halleb, shenneemar "velechem lebab enosh yisad":

Ukebod habberaka hi libtzoa perusat habberaka bammaqom hayyapeh shebbappat, vehu maqom shenneepa yapeh venitqashsha yapeh heteb meapiyya, shehu mubchar shebbappat, velo mimmaqom harak, kegon im hebiu lepanayv pat perusa — lo yibtza meemtzaitah shehu rak, ella yibtza millemala shehu maqom hammubchar shebbappat bepat shalem. Veyesh omerim shetztzarik libtzoa mimmaqom shemmatchil liqrom ulehitbashshel techilla keshenneepet happat battannur. Ubattannurim shellanu shemmoshibin happat al shule hattannur — yesh omerim shetztzad haelyon matchil lehitbashshel techilla mechom avir hattannur. Veyesh omerim shetztzad hattachton mitbashshel techilla mechom shule hattannur, shehayeta esh boeret alayv. Velatzet yede shenehem — yesh libtzoa mitztzidde happat, velachtok mitztzad haelyon umeat mitztzad hattachton, ap al pi shehaiqqar kisbara acharona, apillu battannurim shebbimehem shehayeta esh boeret beshule hattannur bishat apiyyat happat shehayeta medubbeqet bedapnotayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rn"d. Veyibtza batztzad shekkeneged hammitbaqqea, ki zeh hatztzad hitchil leapot venidchaqa haissa ad shennitbaqqa hatztzad shekkenegdo:

Mitzva min hammubchar lebarek al happat keshehi shelema, velo leporsah techilla veachar kak lebarek aleha im hebiu lepanayv shelema. Veap im hebiu lepanayv perusa — mitzva min hammubchar lebarek aleha kak keshehi perusa gedola, velo yipros mimmenna ad leachar habberaka. Vetzarik shettikleh kol habberaka beod shehi shelema o perusa gedola. Vegam achar sheggamar habberaka — lo yibtza ad sheyyikleh aniyyat "amen" mippi rob haonim im yotzeim yede chobatam bebirkato, lepi sheggam aniyyat "amen" mikkelal habberaka hi. Abal hammiut hammaarikim yoter midday — en tzarik lehamtin alehem, shekkol hammaarik be"amen" yoter midday — eno ella toeh. Vetob lachtok meat besakkin perusat habbetzia min hallechem qodem sheyyatchil lebarek, kede shello yapsiq bishhiyyat hachittuk ben beraka laakila, veeno mapridah mimmennu ad achar shettikleh kol habberaka. Veen hallechem chashub keparus al yede chatak muat kazeh, im hu beinyan sheim yochaz bapperusa yaaleh shear hakkikkar immah. Velo yachtok yoter mikkashshiur hazzeh, sheim yachtok yoter, beinyan sheim yochaz bapperusa lo yaaleh shear hakkikkar immah, ap al pi sheim yochaz bakkikkar taaleh happerusa immah — hare zeh keparus lekol dabar. Lepikak, beshabbat veyom tob en lachtok kelal ballechem ad leachar habberaka, ki shemma tishshamet yado veyachtok yoter mikkashshiur hazzeh, venimtza shebbatza al perusa, ubeshabbat tzarik lihyot lechem mishneh shalem. Veen lachosh lehepseq shehiyyat hachittuk ben beraka laakila, shehashshehiyya bilbaddah belo dibbur — enah chashuba hepseq, ella shebbechol osim ken al tzad hayyoter tob. Umikkol maqom, im shakach vechatak beshabbat kemo bechol — lo hipsid hallechem mishneh, shekkol sheochez bapperusa ushear hakkikkar oleh immo — hare hu keshalem lekol dabar. Veuga daqqa gam bechol en tzarik lachtok bah qodem sheyyebarek, kevan sheen shehut bishbiratah achar habberaka:

Mehilkot derek eretz, shello libtzoa perusa qetanna, mippene shennireh ketzar ayin, velo gedola yoter mikkebetza bechol, mippene shennireh keraabtan. Abal beshabbat mitzva libtzoa perusa gedola shettaspiq lo lekol hasseuda, veen lachosh leraabtanut, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ra"d. Vekol zeh kesheokel lebaddo, abal im okel im bene beto o orechim — mitzva min hammubchar libtzoa perusa gedola kol kak sheyyitten lekol hamsubbim hayyotzeim yede chobatam bebirkato mipperusa zo shebberak aleha, velo mehallechem hannishar mimmenna. Veshiur perusat "hammotzi", ben labbotzea ben lekol echad mehamsubbin — yesh omerim shehu lo pachot mikkazzayit, veyoklennu kullo bebat achat. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik kazzayit, shehare apillu kol shehu rauy lebarek "hammotzi", veday shettehe perusat "hammotzi" kachatzi zayit, shello yehe nireh ketzar ayin. Veken nohagin:

Kol habberakot kullan mebarekim otan bilshon abar, velo bilshon hoveh, shehare kebar hotzi min haaretz lechem zeh shehu ba lehanot mimmennu, ukebar bara peri zeh o mazon zeh. Umah shemmebarekin "bore" velo "shebbara", hu, mippene she"bore" hu mashma gam ken leshon abar, kemo shekkatub "bore hashshamayim", laken mebarekin bilshon happasuq. Veken "hammotzi" mashma gam ken leshon abar, kemo shekkatub "hammotzi leka mayim mitztzur hachallamish". Veap al pi sheyyesh maqom litot velomar she"hammotzi" eno moreh lashon abar, kemo shekkatub "hammotzi etkem mittachat siblot mitzrayim", vaadayin lo hotziam az. Veap sheyyesh lomar shekkavvanat hakkatub: shekkeshettetzeu eeseh lakem shettedeu "ki ani Hashem elohekem" hu "hammotzi etkem", uleshon abar hu, mikkol maqom, haya rauy yoter lomar "motzi lechem", shehu lashon meborar al heabar, kemo shekkatub "el motziam mimmitzrayim", ukeshenneemra parashat bilam kebar yatzeu — ap al pi ken mebarekin "hammotzi", kede shello leareb haotiyyot shehem me"m shel "haolam" ume"m shel "motzi", sheim lo yittenu revach benehem — tibbala achat mehen. Umah sheomerim "lechem min" ap al pi sheyyesh irbub otiyyot, hu mippene shehu leshon happasuq: "matzmiach chatzir labbehema vego' lehotzi lechem min haaretz", shekkol habberakot vehattepillot tapesu leshon hakkatub bekol mah deepshar. Vetzarik lizzaher litten revach ben "lechem" uben "min", veken ben shear b' otiyyot sheshshavot babberakot:

En lebarek "hammotzi" qodem sheyyitpos hallechem beyado, kemo sheen mebarekin al hammitzvot ella samuk laasiyyatan, keshehammitzva mezummenet beyado laasotah velo qodem laken, kemo shennitbaer besiman k"h (veim berak veachar kak netalo beyado — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Abal im berak veachar kak hebiuhu lepanayv — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"v):

Tzarik sheyyitpos hallechem bimino, shekkol dabar shemmebarekin alayv — tzarik leechoz beyamin bishat habberaka. Vetob sheyyitten alayv shette yadayv, sheyyesh bahen y' etzbaot keneged y' mitzvot hatteluyot bappat: "lo tacharosh beshor ubachamor", zeriat kilayim, leqet shikcha upea, bikkurim, terumot, maaser rishon vesheni, vechalla. Ulekak yesh y' tebot bebirkat "hammotzi", vey' tebot bappasuq: "matzmiach chatzir labbehema", vey' tebot bappasuq: "ene kol eleka yesabberu", vey' tebot bappasuq "eretz chitta" ku':

Lo yatchil lebarek ad sheyyabiu lepanayv melach o liptan lelappet bo perusa shel beraka, kede shettehe neekelet betaam mishshum kebod habberaka, vaapillu im yitacher haddabar ad sheyyabiu. Veim hamsubbin rabbim — tzarik lehamtin ad sheyyabiu lipne kol echad veechad, shehem yotzeim yede chobatam bebirkato, utzerikim litom miyyad achar birkato, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim hi pat neqiyya, o metubbelet betablin o bemelach keen shellanu, o shennitkavven leekol pat chareba — en tzarik lehamtin. Veim rotzeh lehamtin — hareshut beyado, veen lachosh lehepseq ben netila le"hammotzi", kevan shehu letzorek hasseuda ap al pi sheeno letzorek "hammotzi". Mikkol maqom, nahagu lehanniach melach al hashshulchan, lepi shehashshulchan domeh lemizbeach vehaakila keqorban, veneemar "al kol qorbaneka taqrib melach". Ukesheyyisrael yoshebim al hashshulchan umamtinim zeh al zeh ad sheyyittelu yedehem vehem belo mitzvot — hassatan meqatreg alehem, u"berit melach" megen alehem, laken mitzva lehannicho al hashshulchan apillu lo yoklu mimmennu. Veal pi haqqabbala yesh litbol perusat habbetzia bammelach g' peamim. Vekevan shehashshulchan domeh lemizbeach — tob lizzaher shello laharog alayv kinna (abal lizroq alayv kinna en lachosh, shehare bet hakkeneset sheqqedushshato chamura sheasur leekol bo, veap al pi ken yakol lizroq bo kinna shello bishat hattepilla, kemo she[ni]tebbaer besiman tz"z):

Veachar habberaka yokal miyyad, velo yasiach ben beraka laakila. Veim sach — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, ella im ken hayeta hassicha bidbarim shehem meinyene haddabar shemmebarek alayv, kegon sheamar: habiu melach o liptan. Vaapillu pat shellanu sheen tzarik melach, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu chapetz leekol al yede tibbul bemelach — hare zeh meinyene hasseuda. Veken im amar: tenu liploni leekol. Vaapillu im amar: tenu maakal labbehema — tzorek hasseuda hu veeno chashub hepseq, lepi sheasur leekol qodem sheyyitten libhemto, shenneemar "venatatti eseb besadeka libhemteka", veachar kak: "veakalta vesabota". Abal lishtot — adam qodem, kemo shemmatzinu beribqa sheomra: "sheteh vegam gemalleka ashqeh". Veken akilat aray veen bah kede sebia — yesh mi shemmattir qodem sheyyitten libhemto. Veap al pi ken, kevan shehu tzorek hasseuda ap al pi sheeno tzorek akilat perusa shel beraka — eno chashub hepseq bediabad. Abal lekattechilla asur lehasiach apillu letzorek perusa shel beraka, vaapillu beodo loes, ad sheyyibla. Veim sach beodo loes bedabar sheeno meinyan tzorke hasseuda — epshar shetztzarik lachazor ulebarek, shehare habberaka enah ella al habbelia velo al halleisa, shehalloes veeno bolea — en tzarik lebarek, kemo sheyyitbaer siman r"y. Vetzarik lizzaher gam ken shello lelek mimmaqom lemaqom ad sheyyibla, ki halika mimmaqom lemaqom chashuba hepseq. Ella im ken hi letzorek haakila, sheaz muttar lekattechilla im i epshar beinyan acher, kegon shei epshar lo lebarek bimqom akilato, lepi sheeno naqi, shekkevan shei epshar lo leekol beinyan acher — hare zeh kediabad. Vehu sheb' hammeqomot hem bebayit echad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"ch:

Vaapillu achar shettaam hambarek, im sach echad mehamsubbin qodem sheyyitom — tzarik hammesiach lachazor ulebarek leatzmo, im sach bedabar sheeno meinyan tzorke seuda, ki lo tehe shemiato habberaka mehambarek gedola mehambarek atzmo vehaya mesiach ben beraka laakila, shehaya tzarik lachazor ulebarek mishshum shehipsiq ben beraka laakila, veap zeh hipsiq ben shemia laakila, shehashshomea kimbarek. Veken rabbim sheosim mitzva achat veechad mebarek lekullam, im hipsiq echad mehem ben shemiat habberaka laasiyyat hammitzva, ap al pi shehambarek kebar asa hammitzva tekep lebirkato — en zeh moil lazeh shehipsiq benetayim, vetzarik hu lachazor ulebarek leatzmo. Umikkol maqom, im beshaa shehabbotzea haya mebarek "hammotzi" haya echad mehamsubbin notel yadayv vekivven lebirkat "hammotzi" veachar kak niggeb yadayv uberak "al netilat yadayim" — yotze bebirkat habbotzea, veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek birkat "hammotzi", shebbirkat "al netilat yadayim" enah chashuba hepseq ben "hammotzi" laakila, lepi shehu tzorek hasseuda:

Shakach veakal velo berak "hammotzi", im nizkar betok hasseuda — mebarek al mah sheyyokal meatta. Veim lo nizkar ad sheggamar seudato — en mebarek al mah sheakal, shebbirkat hannehenin doma lebirkat hammitzvot, sheen mebarekim ella ober laasiyyatan velo achar kak, ella im ken hi mitzva shei epshar lebarek aleha ober laasiyyatan, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch. Veyesh mi shechilleq ben birkat hannehenin leben birkat hammitzvot, sheyyakol lebarek achar kak im lo berak lipnehem. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kassebara harishona, tob lachosh lidbarayv bebirkat hannehenin, sheepshar lo leekol od meat vibarek battechilla, veyotze ledibre hakkol:

Im hu mesuppaq im berak birkat "hammotzi" im lav — eno chozer umebarek, ki birkat "hammotzi" middibre soperim usepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Veeno rashshay lehachamir al atzmo ella shello leekol, abal lo lebarek, shello likkanes lispeq beraka lebattala:

Im bimqom birkat "hammotzi" berak "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", o sheamar "berik rachamana malka (dealma) mareh dehay pitta", vaapillu lo hizkir shem happat kelal, sheamar "mareh dehay", vehayeta happat munnachat lepanayv — yatza, veeno niqra "meshanneh mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim", kevan shebberak al happat sheokel vehizkir shem umalkut bebirkato, ki "rachamana" hu shem h bebabel (ap al pi shebbattargum hu kinnuy shel "rachum"):

Rabbim shennitvaadu leekol — echad mebarek lekullam, vehashshear yekavvenu libbam lishmoa veyaanu "amen", vehambarek yekavven la"amen" sheomerim. Vaapillu hem shenayim lebad, shebbebirkat hammazon kol echad mebarek leatzmo — echad mehem mebarek "hammotzi", lepi shebbesop hasseuda hem mitpordim zeh mizzeh, lepikak enan mitztorpin libraka achat ella bezimmun shelosha, mah sheen ken bitchillat hasseuda shehem mitchabberim veqobeim atzman leekol yachad:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehesebu al hammittot shehu derek qeba, shekken haya minhagam keshemmitchabberim leekol bachabura achat haya kol echad meseb al mittato, velo haya qobea seuda belo hasibba im hem orechim hassoadim etzel baal habbayit, shedderek latet lekol echad veechad bipne atzmo al hashshulchanot haqqetannim asher lipne kol echad veechad, veenam yodeim qebiutam ad shehesebu yachad. Abal im yoshebin belo hasibba al hammittot — adayin enan qebuim yachad, vekol echad mebarek leatzmo. Abal baal habbayit im bene beto, ap al pi sheyyashebu belo hasibba — hare hem qebuim beyachad, lepi shekkol bene habbayit nigrarim achar baal habbayit, veechad mebarek lekullam. Vaapillu bene chabura sheenam baal habbayit im bene beto, im ameru: nokal kan o bemaqom peloni, kevan shehekinu maqom laakilatam — hare niqbeu yachad apillu lo hesebu, velo ameru shetztzerikin hasibba ella kesheyyashebu pitom beli shum amira techilla leekol yachad bemaqom zeh. Veakshav sheen anu regilin bahasibba, hare yeshibatenu beshulchan echad, o belo shulchan bemappa achat — chashuba qebiut apillu libne chabura, kemo hasibba bimehem. Abal im enam yoshebin al shulchan echad o mappa achat — enan qebuim yachad, apillu hekinu maqom laakilatam, vaapillu baal habbayit im bene beto. Vehashshammash ap al pi sheeno qabua bishiba etzel hashshulchan, ella omed umeshammesh veokel belo qeba, sheholek uba tamid beemtza akilato — yotze bebirkat habbotzea, lepi sheddarko bekak, vezo hi qebiuto, laamod lesharet veleekol:

Bammeh debarim amurim shetztzarik shulchan echad o mappa achat? Babbayit, abal bassadeh day bahakanat maqom, sheyyomru: nokal kan o bemaqom peloni. Vaapillu haya kol echad rokeb al behemto veokel mikkikkaro, kevan sheamedu bemaqom echad — niqbeu yachad ap al pi shello yaredu mehabbehemot. Abal im hayu holekin veokelim — lo niqbeu, ap al pi sheameru: nokal yachad, vaapillu mehallekin beraglehem veokelim mikkikkar echad. Abal im holekim bispina achat veameru: nokal — niqbeu baamira zo, apillu kol echad okel mikkikkaro, vaapillu shello al mappa achat. Abal im yoshebim baagala — yesh lehistappeq im dinam kerokebim al gabbe behema, shehaagala gam ken mehalleket, mah sheen ken bispina shehi enah chashuba mehalleket, ella hammayim holekim tachteha vehi nacha leolam al otam hammayim. O epshar: kevan shehem yoshebim baagala achat — mitztorpin, mah sheen ken berokebim, sheap shehem yoshebim — hare kol echad hu rokeb bipne atzmo. Veim hayu okelim bassadeh mepuzzarim umeporadim, ap al pi sheokelin kullam beshaa achat umikkikkar echad, kevan shello qabeu maqom veokelin mepuzzarin — en mitztorpin:

Kol maqom sheen mitztorpin mippene shello niqbeu yachad vekol echad mebarek leatzmo, im berak echad lekullam, ap al pi shennitkavven lehotziam yede chobatam vehem nitkavvenu latzet — lo yatzeu, shebbirkat hannehenin enah doma lebirkat hammitzvot shekkol hammechuyyab baddabar motzi chabero yede chobato, abal bebirkat hannehenin mi shennehena hu rauy sheyyebarek, veen echad poter chabero bebirkato ella im ken niqbeu yachad al dabar shedderek liqboa alayv, kegon pat veyayin, sheqqebiutam metzaraptan lihyotam nechshabim kegup echad libraka achat lekullam. Abal im niqbeu yachad ella shekkol echad tzarik lebarek leatzmo mippene sheen qebiutam moelet, kegon bebirkat hammazon bepachot mig', o beraka acharona shel perot — kol echad veechad mebarek leatzmo. Veim berak echad lekullam — yatzeu yede chobatam bediabad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qtz"g vry"g. Veyesh omerim shebbekol maqom yatzeu yede chobatam bediabad. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona:

Vekol maqom sheqqebiutam moelet letzorpam libraka achat — mitzva sheechad mebarek lekullam velo kol echad bipne atzmo, mishshum shenneemar: "berab am hadrat melek". Umikkol maqom, rashshaim hem liqboa yachad al daat shello lehitztarep, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"g. Ulepikak, nahagu akshav lebarek kol echad leatzmo, mishshum shehehamon lo hayu nizharim millehasiach ben shemiat habberaka lehatteima, laken hinhigu lebarek kol echad leatzmo. Vekevan shennahagu ken — hare zeh keillu hayeta datam beperush biqbiutam yachad, sheqqobeim al daat shello lehitztarep, upeturin mehiddur zeh:

Bene chabura sheen benehem baal habbayit o shekkullam baale battim — gadol bechokma shebbahem hu habbotzea mishshum kebodo, o noten reshut lemi sheyyirtzeh. Veim hem shavin veechad mehem kohen — mitzva lehaqdimo. Veim kohen am haaretz vehu talmid chakam — hu qodem lo. Veasur lechakam lehaqdim et am haaretz lepanayv derek choq umishpat kehunna, ella im ken mochel lo venoten lo reshut lebarek belo kehunnato, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"a. Veim hakkohen gam ken talmid chakam ella shehayyisrael gadol mimmennu — tob lehaqdimo lehakkohen, abal eno chayyab baddabar. Veim maqdimo — maarik yamim. Veim yesh benehem baal habbayit — hu qodem apillu lekohen talmid chakam, kede sheyyibtza beayin yapa. (Ap sheqqedimat hakkohen hi min hattora, mikkol maqom, min hassetam mochel lo hakkohen bikbodo bishbil zeh. Veap im eno mochel lo — en lo qedima babbetzia neged baal habbayit, shehare beyad habbaal habbayit shello litten lo leekol kelal, sheen zeh mimmishpete hakkehunna lehaakilam bechinnam. Veap im hu sekiro — eno mechuyyab litten lo kan akshav, ella leachar zeman o bemaqom acher. Mah sheen ken bebirkat hammazon, shekkebar akal venitchayyeb bebirkat hammazon im kullam yachad — hu qodem lekullam, im eno mochel lahem). Veim ba lachaloq kabod legadol mimmennu — rashshay. Veken nahagu. Veken hechatan beyom chatunnato — hu qodem lakkol libtzoa, ap al pi sheyyesh sham gadol vekohen, shekkevan shehasseuda hi bishbilo ubeyado lidchotah — en qedima negdo leshum adam. Umiddat anava hi sheap shehabbotzea hu haggadol — notel reshut mikkol bene hachabura, veomer battechilla: "birshut moray verabbotay", keillu hem gedolim mimmennu velahem naeh lebarek. Venahagu littol reshut mikkohen lebirkat hammazon. Veken nakon, shehare mitzva lehaqdimo, veim ken asur lebarek belo reshuto, ella im ken gadol mimmennu bechokma. Umikkol maqom, en moil mah sheomer "birshut" im lo natan lo hakkohen reshut:

En hamsubbim rashshaim litom ad sheyyitom habbotzea, kegon im hem rotzim lachtok min hallechem shebbatza mimmennu habbotzea velitom qodem sheyyitom hu. Abal hu lo yitten lahem kelal qodem sheyyitom, shello lehapsiq bishhiyyat netina zo ben beraka laakila shello letzorek, shehare hem enam rashshaim litom mah shennoten lahem ad sheyyitom hu techilla. Veim kol echad okel mikkikkaro, veen zequqim lakkikkar shebbeyad habbotzea — rashshain litom mikkikkerotehem qodem sheyyitom habbotzea mikkikkaro. Raq sheyyamtinu ad sheyyikleh "amen" mippi rob haonim, kemo shehabbotzea tzarik lehamtin, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Ubeshabbat veyom tob tzarik lihyot lipne hamsubbin lechem mishneh chutz mimmah shellipne habbotzea, veaz rashshain litom qodem habbotzea, sheim lo ken zequqim hem lakkikkar shellipne habbotzea, latzet bahen yede chobat lechem mishneh. (Vegam bechol tzarik lihyot lipnehem kikkar shalem kemo lipne habbotzea, sheim lo ken zequqim hem lekikkar shalem shellipne habbotzea, shekkevan sheyyesh al hashshulchan pat shelema — asur libtzoa al happerusa, ella al derek sheyyitbaer besiman qs"ch). Veim ba habbotzea lachaloq kabod lemi sheggadol mimmennu sheyyitom techilla — hareshut beyado. Veyesh choleqin:

Habbotzea hu poshet yado techilla laqqeara leekol, veim ba lachaloq kabod lemi sheggadol mimmennu — rashshay. Habbotzea noten perusa lipne kol echad vehaacher notelah beyado, ella im ken haokel hu abel. Vekol ellu mimminhage derek eretz shennahagu chakme yisrael basseuda. Ubeshabbat en abelut noheget. Veyizzaher habbotzea shello yizroq chatikat "hammotzi" lipne hamsubbin, sheasur lizroq happat apillu al hashshulchan, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"a:

Tob lizzaher shello lehaakil perusat habbetzia lenokri o libhema vaop, mishshum kebod habberaka, veyesh leoklah qodem sheyyokal pat acheret, kede shettehe neekelet leteabon mishshum chibbub mitzva. Veyesh omerim shettob leoklah besop hasseuda. Veharotzeh latzet yede shenehem — yokal qetzat battechilla uqetzat bassop:

Mi sheeno okel — eno yakol lebarek "hammotzi" lehotzi haokelin yede chobatan, apillu enan yodein lebarek leatzman, kevan shehu eno mechuyyab bibraka zo, vekol sheeno mechuyyab baddabar — eno motzi acherim yede chobatan, shebbirkat hannehenin enah doma lebirkat hammitzvot, sheap mi sheeno mechuyyab baddabar mippene shekkebar yatza yede chobato yakol lebarek lemi sheadayin lo yatza veeno yodea lebarek leatzmo, kegon leqaddesh qiddush hayyom lenashim veamme haaretz, lepi shebbemitzvot shehen choba — kol yisrael arebim zeh bazeh, vegam hu niqra mechuyyab baddabar keshechabero lo yatza yede chobato adayin, mah sheen ken bebirkot hannehenin, sheap shehen choba al hanneheneh, mikkol maqom, beyado shello lehanot veshello lebarek, lepikak en acher sheen neheneh niqra mechuyyab bidbar habberaka zo, shezzeh tzarik lebarek al mah shechapetz lehanot. Vaapillu beshabbat shehu chayyab leekol pat, mikkol maqom, kevan shechiyyub zeh eno ella lahanaato, sheim eno neheneh baakilato vehattaanit oneg lo patur milleekol, im ken, im eno yodea lebarek gam ken — lo yehaneh, sheasur lehanot mehaolam hazzeh belo beraka, veen kol yisrael arebim sheyyehaneh zeh. Abal kol akila ushetiyya shehen choba al haadam shello mishshum hanaato, kegon matztza belel rishon shel pesach, veyayin shel qiddush, ben shel layla uben shel yom, im eno yodea lebarek — yakol acher shekkebar yatza lehotzio yede chobato ap mibbirkat hannehenin shebbahen, shehen "hammotzi" u"bore peri haggapen", veen tzarik lomar birkat akilat matztza ubirkat haqqiddush atzmah shehem mibbirkot hammitzvot. Veim meqaddesh al happat — motzio gam mibbirkat "hammotzi" shebbaqqiddush, shehi choba mishshum qiddush velo mishshum hanaato. Vekol zeh legadol sheeno yodea lebarek, abal liqtannim rashshay lebarek kol birkat hannehenin kede lechannekan bemitzvot, vaapillu en chinnukam muttal alayv, kegon sheenan mibbene beto:
